Opioids are substances with an affinity for the opioid receptors Mu (MOP) Kappa (KOP), and Δ (DOP). 

Opioid receptors are all G inhibitory protein coupled receptors →↓cAMP

→ Presynaptically inhibits voltage gated Ca2+ channels →↓neurotransmitter release

→ Postsynapticlly →↑K+ efflux → hyperpolarisation 

**Desired Effects**

+-------------+--------------------------+----------------+
| **Effect ** | **Anatomical Location ** | **Receptor/s** |
+=============+==========================+================+
| Analgesia   | Spinal                   | MOP, KOP, DOP  |
|             |                          |                |
|             | Supra Spinal             | MOP            |
+-------------+--------------------------+----------------+
